column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-10 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   items     the arm slugs, Gate-1 and Gate-2 case names, and mutant names the run read
#   metrics   the metric keys in gen/dsl/phase10/phase-results.tsv
#   checks    the check ids tools/phase10_gate.py implements
# The 24 items are partitioned so each is claimed exactly once. `app-byte-invariance` and
# the nine capability arms sit on the closed-union surface together, because the union's
# closure is exactly the claim that all nine arms are present and no tenth is.
# and `phase10-validation-locus-ledger` have no case, mutant, or metric of their own, so
# the ledger carries them UNVERIFIED rather than asserting a result the run did not
# produce. The gap is recorded against Phase 10 in legacy_tracking_for_deletion.md.
